editorial_intent: Show a researcher examining a 3D medical volume on a screen, conveying the computational elegance of reconstructing full images from sparse data.
subject: A researcher's hand pointing at a 3D CT or MRI volume on a monitor
setting: A dimly lit medical imaging lab with multiple monitors displaying scans
composition: Landscape, with the researcher in the foreground and the glowing monitor as the main focal point, depth of field blurring the background
avoid: frightened expressions, disability stereotypes, pills in hands, miracle imagery, generic retirement poses, overly bright clinical settings, literal medical promises
search_queries: researcher pointing at 3D CT scan monitor
medical imaging lab with MRI screen
scientist analyzing volumetric data on computer
